text:
zoe: Dropping a quick mock of the "Confirm schema change" modal for model endpoints. We're trying to choose between urgent/danger copy vs calm instructive tone. Two-line body max. Primary CTA options: `Apply changes` (clear) or `Save and apply` (explicit). Secondary: `Save as draft` or `Cancel`. Need microcopy that communicates risk: changing schema may break clients. Thoughts?
sam: I like short primary CTA. `Apply changes` feels direct. For the body: avoid scary words like "break" alone. Maybe: `Changing the input schema can affect callers. Apply changes to update the live endpoint.`
anya: Agree to avoid alarmist phrasing. My draft: Title: `Confirm schema change` Body: `These changes update the live endpoint and may affect clients. Review your callers before applying.` Primary: `Apply changes` Secondary: `Save as draft` Tertiary link: `View diff`
ryan-a11y: A11y notes: make sure the modal includes `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby` for the title. For the primary CTA, clear text is essential; avoid punctuation that confuses SR. `Apply changes` is fine. For `Save as draft`, include `aria-describedby` that explains drafts don't affect live traffic. Also ensure the diff link is keyboard focusable and opens in a new modal or panel — SR should be notified when the diff opens.
zoe: Good call — I want a one-line helper under the body for the draft explanation rather than extra aria text if possible: `Drafts are saved but do not change the live endpoint.` But that duplicates SR instructions. ryan-a11y?
ryan-a11y: That helper works visually, but still add `aria-describedby` on the draft button to reference the helper text for screen readers. Also check color contrast on the tertiary link; it needs AA against background. Use `aria-pressed` for toggle-like controls only, not links.
sam: UX nit: `Apply changes` vs `Save and apply` — users sometimes miss that `save` implies persisted; we already persist immediately on apply. I'd avoid `Save` in primary so it's concise. Keep `Save as draft` for the safe option.
anya: Copy tweak to reduce length: Body option B: `These changes update the live endpoint and may require client updates.` Shorter and still accurate.
zoe: Proposed final copy so we can update Figma: Title: `Confirm schema change` Body: `These changes update the live endpoint and may require client updates.` Primary CTA: `Apply changes` Secondary CTA: `Save as draft` Tertiary action (link-style): `View diff` Helper text (small): `Drafts are saved but do not affect the live endpoint.` A11y: `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="confirm-schema-title" aria-describedby="confirm-schema-desc"` Primary gets initial focus, add `aria-describedby` on Save as draft pointing to the helper text, ensure contrast on View diff.
ryan-a11y: :white_check_mark: LGTM. Small suggestion: include `data-alert-level="warning"` for devs to style icons and SR announcements.
zoe: Thanks — I'll push updated mock and export copy tokens. We'll run a quick usability spot-check in tomorrow's design review. :rocket:
design-bot: Thread closed after 2 days of inactivity.
